name: pulse
description: Web integration platform focused on Shopify and Khaos Control
summary: Keeps Shopify online stores and Khaos Control ERP in sync by automating updates of products, stock levels, customer orders, and shipping information. Operations teams use it to avoid manual data entry errors and ensure both systems always show accurate, up-to-date information. It also provides a dashboard to monitor sync status and manage configurations, making cross-platform order fulfilment smoother and more reliable.
